rv.q: Though the idea is compelling, the execution is shaky.
Schaefer crafts a sci-fi epic worthy of Shakespeare's approbation.
A worthwhile and unique take on The Tempest, Prospera! is evocative of sci-fi giants and will delight fans of Shakespeare, Lucas, and Roddenberry alike.
Playwright Schaefer includes too many plot threads and minutiae in her otherwise interesting story.
With a strong ensemble of actors, a modernized premise, and incredibly imaginative costumes, this is a really interesting twist on The Tempest .
Prospera stands out by honoring the essence of Shakespeare’s final work while boldly transforming it into a futuristic sci-fi epic.

Schaefer’s adaptation offers a thoughtful and emotionally resonant expansion of Shakespeare’s themes, especially in its treatment of revenge, legacy, and forgiveness, yet the production’s ambitious sci-fi framework demands more clarity..

cn.t: This sci-fi reimagining of The Tempest earns praise for its imaginative concept and striking visuals, though critics note the adaptation becomes overly complicated and sometimes struggles to provide sufficient context for audiences.
